facts_of_case: Petitioner seeks transfer of petition filed by respondent under Section 9 of Hindu Marriage Act from Court of learned Additional District Judge, Doda to the Court of learned Principal/Additional Principal Judge, Family Court, Jammu. Petitioner has already filed complaint under Domestic Violence Act which is pending disposal before the Court of learned JMIC Munsiff, Jammu.

legal_principles.principle: A party cannot be allowed to forum shop by filing a petition in a different court when the same issue is already pending before another court.
legal_principles.held: It is stated by learned counsel for the petitioner that the respondent has already filed a complaint under Domestic Violence Act which is pending disposal before the Court of learned JMIC Munsiff, Jammu since 22.12.2021.

outcome.final_order: Proceedings in the case titled Manoj Kumar Vs. Anu Bhav pending before the Court of learned Additional District Judge, Doda shall remain stayed till next date of hearing.

keywords: Latin maxim: Nemo judex in causa sua
use_for_drafting: advising on transfer of cases between courts
